title: Must, can and should
description: Talk about obligation, ability, permission and advice.

blocks.text: Muszę means I must, mogę means I can or I may, and umiem means I know how to. Powinienem, said by a man, and powinnam, said by a woman, mean I should. All of them are followed by an infinitive. Some words never change for the person: trzeba (it is necessary), można (one can, it is allowed) and nie wolno (it is not allowed).

blocks.note: Umiem is for a learned skill; mogę is for possibility or permission.
To a woman: Powinnaś więcej spać.

blocks.translation: You need to buy a ticket.
blocks.note: Trzeba names no person: it is necessary.

blocks.translation: Can one pay by card here?

lines.speaker: Jan
lines.text: Przepraszam, czy tu można kupić bilet?
lines.translation: Excuse me, can one buy a ticket here?

lines.speaker: Kasjerka
lines.translation: Yes. Where do you want to go?

lines.speaker: Jan
lines.text: Muszę być w Gdańsku o piątej.
lines.translation: I have to be in Gdańsk at five.

lines.speaker: Kasjerka
lines.text: W takim razie powinien pan jechać pociągiem o pierwszej.
lines.translation: In that case you should take the one o'clock train.
